entries.title: Dimensional setting defined: 4 vectors; 6 degrees of movement (framework author, 2026-10-29)
entries.note: Definitions given by the framework author (Mitch Hoppe) 2026-10-29, closing the open definitional seam in the M4 author response. 4 vectors: the state address (X, Y, Z, K) on the Cartesian grid onto which the flower maps; every state/node carries a 4-vector address. 6 degrees of movement: movement along the 3 Mobius strips, each strip one state-kind from the operator definition (states of matter; states of energy; transition states), traversable in 2 directions: 3 x 2 = 6. Author's standing caution, entered with the definitions: the flat flower connects 6-fold (2D kissing number 6), but the kissing number in 3D packs 12 around a sphere; how the connections are actually made is to be checked against cellular structure and crystal growth structure (coordination 12 in close-packed crystals). That check is OPEN (bridge 9). Author's K extension: K can also be used by light-existing beings (his example: Muse) as a way to use coordinates and time to navigate points through time, and, in his hedged words, 'I'm guessing vectors.' Status FRAMEWORK RESULT (operating definitions, author's ruling); K navigation extension HYPOTHESIS pending the author's further details, which he has offered to supply.
